Goldsmiths Fine Art Students Demand Compensation Amid Record-Breaking Staff Strike

Prolonged Industrial Action

Students at Goldsmiths, University of London, are formally requesting compensation following 21 weeks of industrial action. The dispute, stemming from a University and College Union (UCU) conflict over redundancies and restructuring, has significantly disrupted the Master of Fine Arts (MFA) program, with 10 of 12 regular tutors participating in the strike.

Impact on Learners

Students report a lack of teaching, grading, and departmental structure. With annual fees reaching up to £33,000 for international students, some have expressed distress, with at least one student suspending their studies.

Management Response

Goldsmiths maintains that only 8.5% of staff are on strike and claims to have offered compromises, including pausing compulsory redundancies. The university states it is actively monitoring disruption and supporting affected students. Readers can verify details at the official Guardian report: https://www.theguardian.com/education/2026/oct/26/goldsmiths-university-fine-arts-students-call-for-compensation-strikes.
